1. Nc1+ {The knight gives check, at his queen's bishop's square.} Kb2 {The king, at the adverse

queen's knight's fourth square.} Kb3 {The king, at the adverse queen's knight's third square.}
4. Nd3 {The knight, at his queen's third square. (a) NOTE: He cannot push his pawn without
receiving a double check from your knight; therefore it is a drawn-game. It is necessary to
observe, that in such positions, when the knight cannot give check, nor hinder the pawn from
going forwards, a double check must necessarily happen at the second move. A DRAWN-GAME, Or a
PARTY won, with two PAWNS against one.} *
